footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to CBL & Associates Properties: includes $1.4M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests; after $2.1M of other adjustments to common shareholders. The data provider reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow. Operating income follows StockAnalysis, which places unusual items below the operating line: −$3.2M asset writedowns, $108M gains/losses on asset sales, −$217K other unusual items in 2025; −$1.5M asset writedowns, $16.7M gains/losses on asset sales, $25.9M other unusual items in 2024 (signs as reported: negative = charge).

Figures are from StockAnalysis (S&P Global Market Intelligence data) for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier; free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items not reported there are left out.
Diluted EPS by quarter as reported in the 10-Qs; fourth quarters are calculated (net income ÷ estimated diluted shares) because EPS does not add across quarters.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: CBL & Associates Properties is a REIT that owns and manages shopping malls, outlet centers and open-air centers. Revenue rose 12.2% to $578M in 2025. Operating income rose 5.6% to $140M, a 24.2% margin.
Net income rose 2.3× to $134M, or $4.34 per share. Operating cash flow was $250M and free cash flow $250M, versus $202M; CBL & Associates Properties returned $76.3M through dividends and buybacks.
